config_entries.label: Name
config_entries.description: The name of the effect. Defaults to `Flicker`.

config_entries.label: Alpha
config_entries.description: A smoothing factor that controls how much "memory" the flicker has. A high value makes the flicker's next step very similar to its last, which smooths out changes. A low value mixes more of the new value, resulting in rapid changes. Defaults to `95%`.

config_entries.label: Intensity
config_entries.description: The magnitude of the random change applied at each step. As the changes are applied across color channels, higher values produce more visible shifts. Defaults to `1.5%`.
